title: A. Concept
description: A versioned definition shared across systems: what a value means, how it is computed or where it is canonical, and the fixtures every implementation must pass.

kind.description: Derived values are recomputed and never mutated; authoritative ones are canonical and mutated only through the DataGuard.

output.description: The fields the Concept produces, each with its type and constraints.

inputs.description: The data the Concept is computed from, as `<entity>.<field>`.

conformance.description: Path to the executable fixtures, relative to this file.

deprecates.description: The version this one replaces; it stays available while a Capability implements it.
